intent: A reusable intact forged-iron face system for straps and plates. This capability proves measured stock scale, finite tool-scale plane changes, quiet forge skin, and a physically separated metal/oxide response before weathering or damage.

primary_object.use: Construction hierarchy and iron-face hue relationships after explicit metal, wood, oxidation, and shadow classification.

secondary_object.use: Secondary hierarchy reference for broad medieval iron strapwork against oak.

met_55_61_63.use: Narrow reference strap width and length.

measured_forging_tool.use: Later-period measured tool envelopes provide a maximum footprint for the two authored mark classes. They do not claim that every medieval blow printed the whole face.

surface_roughness_proxy.authors: B. Gerin, E. Pessard, F. Morel, C. Verdu
surface_roughness_proxy.title: Characterising the impact of surface integrity on the fatigue behaviour of a shot-peened connecting rod
surface_roughness_proxy.use: Modern measured micro-roughness proxy only. The paper explicitly shows that equal Ra values can hide different topographies, so finite forge-plane masks remain a separate authored layer.

pbr.rule: Measured iron base colour is linear 0.560, 0.570, 0.580. Metallic is binary for pure surfaces: 1 for exposed iron and 0 for the dielectric forge skin or oxide.

conservation.rule: Stable iron may range from silver-grey through compact blue-black and red-brown; bright orange powder, blisters, flaking, and pits indicate active corrosion and are excluded from this core material.

coordinate_contract.scale_rule: Geometry authors emit longitudinal and cross-stock coordinates in metres before assembly. Macro fabrication coordinates divide those metre lanes by sinc_iron_fabrication_scale. Scale and micro use the 1.218 by 0.164 m raw-metre field; worked response uses an independent 2.436 by 0.492 m raw-metre field. sinc_seed selects a deterministic atlas row without stretching stock.

pattern.placement_rule: A hand-authored champion layout defines clustered planishing and cross-peen events with quiet intervals. Scripted variants perturb position, rotation, and strength inside measured tool envelopes; they do not replace the layout with noise.

surface_response.metallic_rule: The retained blue-black forge scale is a continuous dielectric skin. Hammering never implies exposed conductive iron. The conductor branch is reachable only from a separately authored contact-polish mask, whose default amount is zero.

height_encoding.rule: Measured-proxy micro-topography is added to finite sub-millimetre hammer-plane and scale-lip relief. It never displaces the silhouette.

distance_response_m.rule: Only the micro normal fades with camera distance. Macro hammer and scale-lip normals remain stable.

normal_strengths.rule: Macro hammer, compact-scale lip, micro topography, and finite worked-face normals remain independently adjustable before whiteout blending.

palette.normalization_rule: Only the eleven audited iron-face samples preserve warm/cool hue relationships. Their photograph luminance is discarded. The six shadow or material-ambiguous samples are excluded, and the three red-brown samples belong only to the default-off oxidation overlay.

layers.purpose: A continuous dielectric blue-black scale skin with broad cool and warm passages and long visual rests between authored events.
Finite overlapping blue-black plate-tone changes within the continuous high-temperature scale skin; not exposed spots, rust, pitting, or generic grunge.
Rounded rectangular plane changes bounded by the measured 41.275 by 31.75 millimetre hammer face. They change plane and reflection but do not change metal identity.
Elongated directional plane changes bounded by the measured 36.5125 by 12.7 millimetre cross-peen face. They change plane and reflection but do not change metal identity.
Band-limited micro-topography normalized to the measured modern as-forged Ra proxy after the finite mark field is assembled.
Finite component-local comparative brush passes alter normal, roughness, anisotropy, and anisotropic rotation while preserving protected quiet regions.
layers.placement_rule: Twelve irregularly spaced passes occupy a worked field twice the base tile length and three times its width. The larger independent coordinate prevents tidy cross-stock rows on giant plate while preserving millimetre bundle spacing.

layers.purpose: Reference-audited red-brown oxidation reserved for a later placement pass.
Exposed iron reserved for geometry-authored contact edges and use logic.
